Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1073/pnas.2110013119: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Deepfake detection by human crowds, machines, and machine-informed crowds', autores Groh, Epstein, Firestone e Picard, ano 2022 (online dez/2021, impresso jan/2022), PNAS; o resumo confirma experimentos com participantes humanos sobre deteccao de deepfakes em video.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0285333: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Warning: Humans cannot reliably detect speech deepfakes', autores Mai, Bray, Davies e Griffin, ano 2023, PLOS ONE; o resumo confirma 'n = 529 individuals', ingles e mandarim, e o trecho 'Listeners only correctly spotted the deepfakes 73% of the time'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1016/j.isci.2021.103364 e o resumo no Europe PMC: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Fooled twice: People cannot detect deepfakes but think they can', autores Kobis, Dolezalova e Soraperra, ano 2021, iScience; o resumo confirma 'In a pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210)' e os quatro achados relatados.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1016/j.chb.2023.107917 e o resumo no repositorio da JCU: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Providing detection strategies to improve human detection of deepfakes: An experimental study', autores Somoray e Miller, ano 2023, Computers in Human Behavior; o resumo confirma 'participants (N = 454)', 20 videos, e o trecho 'correctly categorizing 60.70% of videos on average'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-94170-3: existe, journal-article, titulo 'People are poorly equipped to detect AI-powered voice clones', autores Barrington, Cooper e Farid, ano 2025, Scientific Reports; o resumo confirma estudos perceptuais com participantes humanos sobre clonagem de voz e o trecho 'We find human participants cannot consistently identify recordings of AI-generated voices'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1098/rsos.231214: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Deepfake detection with and without content warnings', autores Lewis, Vu, Duch e Chowdhury, ano 2023, Royal Society Open Science; o resumo confirma experimento com espectadores, deepfake de conteudo neutro, e o trecho 'only 21.6% of respondents correctly identify the deepfake as the only inauthentic video'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1177/09567976231207095: existe, journal-article, titulo 'AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones', autores Miller, Steward, Witkower, Sutherland, Krumhuber e Dawel, ano 2023, Psychological Science; o resumo confirma 'Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults)' e 'Experiment 2 ( N = 610 adults)', e o trecho 'White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces'.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1016/j.visres.2022.108079: existe, titulo 'Are you for real? Decoding realistic AI-generated faces from neural activity', autores Moshel, Robinson, Carlson e Grootswagers, ano 2022, Vision Research; o resumo confirma EEG com humanos, comportamento perto do acaso, e o trecho 'we could reliably decode AI generated faces using people's neural activity'; a mencao a 'fake news' e so contexto de aplicacao.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0332692: existe, titulo 'Voice clones sound realistic but not (yet) hyperrealistic', autores Lavan, Irvine, Rosi e McGettigan, ano 2025, PLOS ONE; o resumo confirma experimento de percepcao com ouvintes e o trecho 'voice clones can sound as real as human voices, making it difficult for listeners to distinguish between them'.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1098/rsos.250921: existe, titulo 'Training human super-recognizers' detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces', autores Gray, Davis, Bunce, Noyes e Ritchie, ano 2025, Royal Society Open Science; o resumo confirma 'SRs (total N = 283)' e 'controls (total N = 381)', e o trecho 'were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls'.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.3389/frai.2025.1707336: existe, titulo 'What you see is not what you get anymore: a mixed-methods approach on human perception of AI-generated images', autores Hogemann, Betke e Thomas, ano 2025, Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence; o resumo confirma 'A total of 104 participants', 50 imagens, metodos mistos, e o trecho 'participants correctly identified AI-generated images in 63.7% of cases overall'.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.3390/brainsci13091233: existe, titulo 'Real and Deepfake Face Recognition: An EEG Study on Cognitive and Emotive Implications', autores Tarchi, Lanini, Frassineti e Lanata, ano 2023, Brain Sciences; o resumo confirma '23 healthy participants', EEG com 21 canais, e o trecho 'deepfakes mainly affected the frontal and occipital areas in the delta band'; o tema e percepcao de faces deepfake, o 'healthy' e descritor da amostra.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1038/s42003-024-06372-6: existe, titulo 'Cortical-striatal brain network distinguishes deepfake from real speaker identity', autores Roswandowitz, Kathiresan, Pellegrino, Dellwo e Fruhholz, ano 2024, Communications Biology; o resumo confirma '25 participants', tarefa de matching de identidade com clones de voz, e o trecho 'Humans can thus be partly tricked by deepfakes'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1093/cybsec/tyad011: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Testing human ability to detect 'deepfake' images of human faces', autores Bray, Johnson e Kleinberg, ano 2023 (online jun/2023, impresso vol. 9), Journal of Cybersecurity; o resumo confirma 'participants (N = 280)', StyleGAN2, quatro grupos, e o trecho 'Overall detection accuracy was only just above chance and none of the interventions significantly improved this'.

Abri o repositorio JCU do DOI 10.5771/2192-4007-2025-4-550: existe, titulo 'Spotting fakes: How do non-experts approach deepfake video detection?', autores Holmes e outros nove, ano 2025, Studies in Communication and Media vol. 14 n. 4; o resumo confirma dois estudos, 'Study 1 (N = 391)' online e 'Study 2 (N = 32)' em laboratorio com eye-tracking, e os trechos 'M = .61, SD = .14' e 'Study 2 found similar levels of detection accuracy (M = .65, SD = .20)'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1002/acp.4245: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Crowds Improve Human Detection of AI-Synthesised Faces', autores Kramer e Cartledge, ano 2024 (vol. 38 n. 5), Applied Cognitive Psychology; o resumo confirma dois experimentos com julgamentos de faces sinteticas e o trecho 'outer crowds as a robust method of improvement during synthetic face detection'; o N nao aparece no resumo.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1186/s41235-025-00683-w: existe, titulo 'AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs', autores Kramer, Jones, Fitousi e Tree, ano 2025, Cognitive Research: Principles and Implications; o resumo confirma quatro experimentos (ChatGPT + DALL-E) e o trecho 'generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs'; celebridades, nao politicos.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1038/s41598-023-42802-x: existe, titulo 'Deepfake smiles matter less-the psychological and neural impact of presumed AI-generated faces', autores Eiserbeck, Maier, Baum e Abdel Rahman, ano 2023, Scientific Reports; o resumo confirma 'participants' (N = 30)', EEG com P1, N170, EPN e LPP, e o trecho 'a dampening effect on perceptual, emotional, and evaluative processing of presumed deepfake smiles'.

Abri o registro Crossref do DOI 10.1177/14614448231199664: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Assessing the perceived credibility of deepfakes: The impact of system-generated cues and video characteristics', autores Jin e outros seis, New Media & Society; o resumo confirma 'two randomized controlled 2 × 2 × 2 experiments ( N = 518)' e o trecho 'high-definition deepfakes are more efficient at deceiving viewers'; o Crossref mostra published-online 2023-09-25 e published-print 2025-03 (vol. 27, p. 1651 a 1672), e fontes externas citam o artigo como 2023, dentro do periodo.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.3390/jimaging11070227: existe, titulo 'Interpretation of AI-Generated vs. Human-Made Images', autores Velasquez-Salamanca, Martin-Pascual e Andreu-Sanchez, ano 2025, Journal of Imaging; o resumo confirma '161 participants-71 visual professionals and 90 non-professionals', Midjourney, DALL-E e Firefly, e o trecho 'human-made images are perceived as both more realistic and more credible than AI-generated ones'.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.3389/frai.2025.1568267: existe, titulo 'Training humans for synthetic face image detection', autores Rehman, Meier, Ibsen, Rathgeb, Nichols e Busch, ano 2025, Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence; o resumo confirma 'we recruited 184 participants', grupo experimental e controle, e o trecho 'training may moderately enhance human capabilities to detect synthetic face images'; o foco e a deteccao humana, nao o algoritmo.

Abri o registro Crossref e o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1016/j.actpsy.2024.104670: existe, journal-article, titulo 'Too beautiful to be fake: Attractive faces are less likely to be judged as artificially generated', autores Makowski e outros seis, Acta Psychologica vol. 252; o resumo confirma '150 participants rated 109 pictures of faces' e o trecho 'with faces rated as more attractive being classified as more real'; online em dez/2024, impresso em fev/2025, dentro do periodo.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1016/j.isci.2022.105441: existe, titulo 'On the realness of people who do not exist: The social processing of artificial faces', autores Tucciarelli, Vehar, Chandaria e Tsakiris, ano 2022, iScience; o resumo confirma 'In three studies' e o trecho 'GAN faces were more likely to be perceived as real than REAL faces'; a mencao a 'political propaganda' e apenas exemplo de uso, o foco e a percepcao de faces.

Abri o resumo no Europe PMC do DOI 10.1038/s41598-023-39944-3: existe, titulo 'Deepfakes and scientific knowledge dissemination', autores Doss e outros sete, ano 2023, Scientific Reports; o resumo confirma survey com cinco populacoes e o trecho '27-50% of individuals cannot distinguish authentic videos from deepfakes'; o estmulo e sobre mudanca climatica, e 'vaccines' e 'political orientation' aparecem so como contexto e moderador, o foco nao e saude nem politica.

Conferi as exclusoes do pedido nos 25 resumos: nenhum e revisao de literatura, meta-analise, preprint, anais de congresso, capitulo, tese ou resenha (todos marcados como research-article ou Journal Article nos registros); nenhum e estudo de deteccao automatica como foco (Groh 2022, Rehman 2025 e Kramer 2024 tem participantes humanos como nucleo); nenhum tem estmulo centrado em politicos, eleicoes, propaganda politica ou saude.

Conferi os anos de publicacao dos 25 artigos nos registros: todos entre 2019 e 2025; os dois casos com online-first em um ano e volume impresso em outro (Jin 2023/2025 e Makowski 2024/2025) tem ambas as datas dentro do intervalo.

Na extracao, atente a quatro pontos: (1) no Groh 2022, confirme o trecho literal no abstract completo do artigo, porque a secao Significance do Crossref traz a frase com outra redacao ('a system integrating human and model predictions is more accurate than either humans or the model alone'); (2) no Jin 2023 (New Media & Society), informe o ano com as duas datas (online 2023, volume impresso 2025) para evitar ambiguidade; (3) no Makowski (Acta Psychologica), faca o mesmo (online dez/2024, volume impresso fev/2025); (4) no Holmes 2025, indique que o N = 32 do Estudo 2 veio da pagina da editora (resumo em alemao), nao do resumo em ingles. Ao copiar os trechos literais na extracao, use as frases continuas dos resumos, sem juntar segmentos nao adjacentes.
